posts.title: My First Job
posts.description: My very first job was in India during the late 90s. I joined a computer-aided design software company in Pune. I had just finished my Ph.D. My first computer at work was a state-of-the-art Sun Sparc workstation. It was bulky, but I loved the keyboard. posts.title: Tripwires
posts.description: Everyone is making the same argument: code is no longer the bottleneck, and the bottleneck has shifted to the phases before and after coding. But describing this as a moving bottleneck understates the change. Beyond the agency and identity attachment challenges I discussed in my previous essay, agentic coding changes not just the volume of work but what it takes to judge, validate, and understand
